role: Extension of RecoveryScoreDetailView with the hero ring, trend comparison, 'What this means', 'Most likely explanations', score breakdown (+ provenance), SpO2 penalty badge, key findings and 'What to do today' sections and their copy builders; plus the RecoveryDetailCopy enum of wording helpers.
types: RecoveryScoreDetailView.Explanation: struct — title/body/badge/badgeColor for an explanation card
RecoveryDetailCopy: enum (@MainActor) — static wording helpers that read no view state

units.does: Hero: ring plus verdict word and delta text, centered.
ScoreRing showing safeDisplayScore(compositeScore) and verdict at 140 pt.
Verdict word in verdict colour and optional '+N% vs your average' line.
TrendComparisonCard(result, recentSessions, baselineStats) when there are at least two recent sessions.
'What this means' heading and NarrativeCard with ScoreBreakdownCopy.message for the breakdown and the load level, accented by verdict colour.
'Most likely explanations' heading plus numbered explanation cards.
Renders buildExplanations() as numbered explanation cards (id = offset).
HRV, sleep and vitals explanations, nils dropped, capped at 3.
HRV explanation by % vs geometric baseline: >5% 'Above', <-10% 'Below', otherwise 'Within your usual range'.

branches.effect: Below-baseline card; otherwise (-10...5) 'Within your usual range' Stable card

units.does: (RMSSD − exp(lnRmssdMean)) / exp(lnRmssdMean) × 100.
Builds the 'Above your baseline' explanation with RMSSD and percent.
Builds the 'Below your baseline' explanation with RMSSD and |percent|.
Sleep explanation graded on measured efficiency: ≥95 Excellent, ≥85 Solid, else Disrupted, with localized duration.

branches.cond: no sleepSnapshot, nightSleepMinutes <= 0, or efficiency not measured

branches.effect: Solid sleep card; otherwise Disrupted sleep card

units.does: Builds the 'Solid sleep' explanation.
Card for whole-night mean HR at least max(SD,3) bpm above meanHRBaseline; body format depends on whether breathing and temperature were measured.

branches.effect: nil; otherwise 'Sleep heart rate above baseline' card

units.does: Builds the 'Disrupted sleep' explanation.

Vitals explanation: HR-above-baseline card when status is normal and HR is high; the Blood Oxygen card when status is elevated by low SpO2 alone; for .normal, the within-usual-range card only when every measured vital was compared (else nil, no card); 'Vitals above baseline' for breathing/temperature elevation or warning.

branches.cond: status normal and HR above baseline
status .elevated with neither breathing nor temperature elevated

branches.effect: 'Vitals above baseline' card; warning: 'Pay attention' / wongAttention, else 'Watch' / wongCaution

units.does: True when each vital present was actually compared: sleep HR only with meanHRBaseline and meanHRSD > 0, breathing and temperature only with their baselines (deviation non-nil); SpO2 is always compared against its floor.
Numbered explanation card layout with header and body text.
Title and coloured capsule badge row.
'Score breakdown' heading, factor rows, weights footnote and scoring provenance.
Two caption lines: scoring version line and the calibrated-not-validated disclaimer.

'Scored before score versions were recorded' when the version is unknown (unversioned breakdown, or a frozen score with no stored breakdown, where the breakdown shown is today's recompute); else 'Scored by <version>'.
One breakdownRow per breakdown factor.
Footnote listing each factor's localized name and weight %, plus fixed prose about HRV/Sleep/Vitals.
Tappable factor row toggling expandedFactor with animation.

branches.effect: collapses (nil); otherwise expands this factor (collapsing any other)

units.does: Factor header, score bar and, when expanded, the factor's displayDetail in the user's temperature unit.
Factor name, display score in factor colour, and '× N%' weight.
6 pt bar filled to factor.score/100 of width.
Colour band for a factor score.
Red-tinted badge with RecoveryDetailCopy.spo2PenaltyText for the penalty points and SpO2 value.
'Key findings' heading and list.
Up to 4 findings rendered as dot rows (ForEach id = the string itself).
Dot + finding text row.
HRV, sleep HR, sleep efficiency, stress and DFA findings with nils dropped.
'HRV N ms' with '±N% vs your average' when a baseline exists.

branches.effect: '+' sign prefix; negative numbers carry their own '-'

units.does: 'Sleep HR N bpm' vs meanHRBaseline: '(at baseline)' within 1 bpm, else '(±N vs baseline)'.
'Sleep efficiency N% across <duration>' when efficiency was measured.

branches.cond: no sleepSnapshot, nightSleepMinutes <= 0 or efficiency unmeasured

units.does: Baevsky stress-index band text: <50 very low, <100 low, <150 normal, <200 elevated, else high.

branches.effect: very low / low / normal / elevated / high by HRVThresholds.stressIndexVeryLow/Low/Normal/Elevated

units.does: States DFA α1 was in 0.75–1.0 when it was; nothing otherwise.
'What to do today' heading and action list.
Up to 3 actions rendered as arrow rows (id = string).
Arrow + action text row.
TrainingAdviceGate assessment of the session's frozen training snapshot (or the result's trainingContext).

branches.effect: falls back to session.analysisResult?.trainingContext; both nil → assess(nil) = .clear

units.does: Action list by verdict: Excellent+clear load → push advice; Excellent held back or Good → goodDayActions; Fair and below → backOffActions.

Good-day actions: lead depends on load (easier → easy aerobic; else normal training), HRV <-10% vs baseline swaps the second line for a moderate-intensity caution, otherwise the load reason line or 'green light' line; sleep line last.

branches.effect: 'Easy aerobic work…' lead; else 'Normal training is on the table…'
'If you wanted a hard session, the green light is there.'

units.does: Back-off actions: Fair, Pay attention, and a firmer rest set for Low/Very low.
Maps a DataSourceSummary.selectedSource tag (an internal tag, not display text) to its catalog label for the engine room's Source row.

branches.effect: the raw tag string shown untranslated

units.does: Maps the fixed English factor label to its localized catalog name.
Format string for the sleep-HR-above-baseline card, mentioning breathing/temperature in range only when both were measured.

branches.cond: vitals nil or respiratoryRate nil or wristTemperature nil
branches.effect: short HR-only sentence; else sentence adding 'Breathing and temperature are in range'

units.does: Explanation card for low SpO2 with breathing and temperature in range: title 'Blood Oxygen (SpO₂)', the vitals-penalty explainer body, badge 'Watch' in wongCaution.
Normal-vitals explanation: 'Sleep heart rate at baseline' when neither breathing nor temperature was measured, else 'All vitals at baseline'.

branches.cond: vitals nil, or respiratoryRate or wristTemperature present
branches.effect: 'All vitals at baseline' card; else the HR-only card

units.does: SpO2 penalty sentence with or without the measured value.

branches.effect: '−N penalty: low SpO₂.'; else 'dropped to N%'

units.does: Parses the stored English windowSelectionReason into a WindowSelectionMethod by prefix.
